title: docs(client, cli): environments.activate and `os environments switch` say the server writes the session's active environment; the cloud route writes nothing (sessionUpdated: false)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ② the framework half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4000 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4006). The card thread measured it (report on cloud#4000, `out_of_scope_findings`), and this is the only place it can be fixed. Dedupe: no objectstack issue names `sessionUpdated`, `active_environment_id` or `environments.activate` (search 2026-11-09).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：SDK 的 `environments.activate` 注释和 CLI `os environments switch` 的注释与 flag 说明，都说服务器会把当前环境写进会话。实际上 cloud 的路由什么都不写，总是回 `sessionUpdated: false`，也没有任何代码读写 `active_environment_id`。当前环境只保存在 CLI 本地的 credentials 里。
- 修法（A，推荐）：只改注释和 flag 说明，如实描述行为，不改代码。cloud#4006 合并后，所有成员调用这个接口都会成功，现有行为不再出错。
- 需要你做的：无，由车道派发。

## Reading (objectstack `main`)

- `packages/client/src/index.ts:3389`: the endpoint list says "POST /api/v1/cloud/environments/:id/activate → set as session's active environment".
- `packages/client/src/index.ts:3704–3707`: the `activate` jsdoc says "The server writes `active_environment_id` on the better-auth session; subsequent requests are routed to this environment's database."
- `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts`:
  - :15–17 says "to update the server-side session".
  - The `--remote` flag description (:50) says "updates the session row".
  - :74 says "the server session is already switched".
  - :108 says "server session unchanged".
- Cloud side, for reference: `routes/environment-crud/retry.ts` (after cloud#4006) reads the row, writes nothing, and answers `sessionUpdated: false`.

## Do

Option A: correct the wording in those five places. The call reads the environment the caller is a member of, and confirms access to it. It writes no server state. The active environment lives in the CLI's local credentials. No behaviour change, no changeset beyond a patch note if the client's published jsdoc counts.

Option B (not recommended here) would drop the default-on `--remote` call. That is a CLI behaviour change and needs the flag's fate decided. Raise it in the report if the reading suggests it.

## Surface

`packages/client/src/index.ts` (jsdoc only), `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts` (comments and the flag description). Clause-②: no.

## Done when

PR merged; no text in client or cli says the server writes or switches a session's active environment.
